proves: JOIN <n> selects the current broadcast channel
BROADCAST <text> broadcasts to members on the selected channel
BROADCAST by itself lists current people on that channel
BR is an explicit alias for BROADCAST
this help body says groups 1 through 127
JOIN <n> is the broadcast-group form of JOIN
JOIN 0 returns to the default broadcast group
this help body says groups 1 through 126
LEAVE while not in a party leaves the current broadcast group
that LEAVE action switches the player to group 0

promoted_exact_intersection.join_numeric: JOIN 0..126 changes the selected broadcast group
promoted_exact_intersection.leave_without_party: LEAVE resets selected broadcast group to 0
promoted_exact_intersection.broadcast_message: BROADCAST <text> targets connected characters in the same world whose selected nonzero broadcast group matches the sender (groups 1..126)
promoted_exact_intersection.broadcast_list: bare BROADCAST/BR lists connected characters in the sender's selected nonzero broadcast group (groups 1..126)
